fluff.overview: Com Guard conventional infantry benefit from ComStar's access to preserved Star League technology, fielding weapons and equipment that match or exceed the standard issue of any Inner Sphere military, backed by the institutional discipline of the secular Order's professional military culture. Mechanized tracked Level I formations ride armored personnel carriers through terrain that would stop wheeled vehicles, providing all-terrain mobility with meaningful armor protection against battlefield hazards. These formations can advance alongside armored Level I units without falling behind on broken ground. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these troops field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
